levels.name: Unclassifiable
levels.description: The question cannot be classified under the configured BL1-BL5 scheme despite sufficient context.

levels.name: Remember
levels.description: Recall facts, terms, definitions, or previously learned information.

levels.name: Understand
levels.description: Explain, describe, summarize, classify, or interpret ideas.

levels.name: Apply
levels.description: Use knowledge or procedures to solve a problem or complete a task.

levels.name: Analyze
levels.description: Examine relationships, distinguish parts, compare, or investigate.

levels.name: Evaluate
levels.description: Make and justify a judgment using criteria, evidence, or standards; assess alternatives, validity, or quality.
